question: Select the sentence which has no spelling error.

options.text: When Reema saw her mother, she was in ecstasy.
Students got in acstasy during inter college baseball match.
Sandeep was in ektasy when his son won a scholarship.
My cousin closed his eyes in extasy at the thought of coffee.

solution:
The solution is** When Reema saw her mother, she was in ecstasy.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence which has no spelling error is " When Reema saw her mother, she was in ecstasy."
 
• Here in this sentence there is no spelling mistake and grammatically correct.
 
• The word **ecstasy **is defined as ***an overwhelming feeling of great happiness or joyful excitement**.*
 
 
• 
 ​​*For example : "There was a look of ecstasy on her face."*
 
 
 
 
• ​​​Therefore **option 1 **is the correct option.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's discuss information about other options:

 
 
• ​In the second option the sentence contains a spelling mistake **acstasy, **the correct spelling is **ecstasy.**
 
• In the third option the sentence contains a spelling mistake **ektasy, **the correct spelling is **ecstasy**.
 
• In the fourth option the sentence contains a spelling mistake **extasy, **the correct spelling is **ecstasy.**
